title: Docker Sandboxes and Docker Agent 101
subtitle: Isolated microVMs for coding agents, and the agent runtime that runs inside them, command by command
summary: How to run an agent you do not trust on files you do. Every listing in this manual comes from a recorded run of sbx and docker-agent on one Mac.
audience: You are an engineer who runs coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex on real repositories. You know Docker, git, and YAML. You have not used Docker Sandboxes or Docker Agent.
outcomes: Run a coding agent inside a sandbox, give it only the files it needs, and get its commits back without giving it your credentials.
Read one line of sbx policy log and say which rule allowed or blocked the connection, and what to change.
Write an agent file that runs a team of agents over local tools and a local model, record it, and replay it from a cassette.
Serve the same agent file over the HTTP API, MCP, ACP, and A2A, and share it as a signed OCI artifact.
Map any command from the 2025 Docker Sandboxes plugin or the cagent material to its current form.

plate.title: One agent, one microVM, one proxy
plate.caption: The agent runs in a microVM that sbx creates, its model call leaves through the host proxy, and the provider keys inside are placeholders. Read top to bottom. From capture/out/27-sandbox-run.txt, 27-inside.txt, and 27-inside-run.txt.

parts.title: The Two Products on One Page
parts.thesis: sbx runs any agent inside a microVM it owns, docker-agent runs an agent file, and docker-agent run --sandbox joins them through a kit and the proxy.

parts.title: sbx run
parts.thesis: A sandbox has a name, a workspace, a template, and a lifecycle that seven verbs and one daemon control.

parts.title: sbx policy, sbx secret, sbx mcp
parts.thesis: Five layers isolate the agent, and each layer has its own commands: the hypervisor, the workspace, the policy and its proxy, the secret store, and the MCP gateway.

parts.title: Kits and sbxenv.yaml
parts.thesis: A kit declares what a sandbox contains and can reach, and an environment file declares the sandbox and its secrets for approval before anything runs.

parts.title: docker-agent run and the Agent File
parts.thesis: An agent file is agents, models, toolsets, and the rules between them, and docker-agent run drives the loop, records it, and replays it.

parts.title: docker-agent serve and share
parts.thesis: One agent file answers over REST and SSE, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MCP, ACP, and A2A, travels as a signed OCI artifact, and runs on a local model.

parts.title: Operating It
parts.thesis: The same sandbox runs in the cloud, an organization narrows it with policies and reads its audit log, old commands map to new ones, and the claims are checked.
